Commentary.Commentary: Now then, the chase is not going to be easy! The ball is moving and Pakistan have some excellent bowlers in their ranks. Can they level the series or will the Kiwis seal it?

For New Zealand, Southee was brilliant. He finished with a four-fer. Neesham and Sodhi too had a decent outing but the others really took a beating. Especially Scott and Jamieson. Had they bowled well, Pakistan would have probably not even crossed 150.

So Pakistan have ended with a really comeptitive score! The innings though did not start off in the best of manners as they lost three in the Powerplay! They kept losing wciets at regular intervals even after that. Hafeez though played a brilliant knock. His fifty was the highlight of this innings for the visitors and he along with a handy cameo from Wasim has taken them to a score they can surely defend.

SIX! HAFEEZ FINISHES ON 99 NOT OUT! If there was anyone who deserved it, it was that man there. But he has run out of balls. Full and on off and middle, Hafeez launches it over the bowler's head.... it goes over the ropes. PAKISTAN FINISH ON 163/6.
EDGY FOUR! Take that again. Full and outside off, Hafeez looks to go big on the off side but he gets a thick outside edge. It flies behind square on the off side and down to the third man fence.
SIX! That is a great place to hit it. Short ball, Hafeez swivels inside his crease and pulls at it. Gets a top edge and the ball goes over fine leg. Short boundary there.
Very full and outside off, Mohammad gets under it and strokes it. It is uppish but lands ahead of mid off. A dot.
Very full and outside off, Imad strokes it down to long on for a run.
Good length ball on off, worked to the off side for a single.
On off, pushed through the covers for a single.
Full and around off, slogged towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Ah... nice. Now, you don't expect that from a tail, don't you? Very full and outside off, Imad Wasim reverse paddles it fine down to the third man boundary.
FOUR! In the air... but a boundary. Almost went for a six. Short and outside off, Wasim moves to the leg side and lofts it over short third man and backward point for a boundary.
Good plan and good execution from Trent Boult. He goes for a yorker. It goes between the legs of Imam, as he looked to play at it.
Full and outside off, Hafeez looks to go big on the leg side but he ends up getting it right off the bottom of the bat. It goes to the on side for a single.

TOP EDGE.... BUT SAFE! Would have been a crowd pleaser had Seifert taken that. Short ball, Mohammad stays on the back foot and goes for the pull shot. He though does not time it well. Gets a top edge. It goes behind square on the leg side. Tim Seifert backtracks and dives but the ball falls away from him, well wide. A single.
Who will come out to the middle now? Imad Wasim. Got a job to do in the last few overs here.

OUT! TAKEN! Sliced it. Just offers the simplest of catches. The New Zealand skipper takes it. Full and outside off, Faheem could not resist. He looked to go big over covers but in the end, ends up splicing it in the air. The easiest of catches for Kane.
Short ball, Hafeez pulls at it but finds the boundary rider at deep square leg. So, just the one.
Fullish and on off, tapped to the off side for a single.
A feeble appeal for LBW but it was going well down the leg pole line. Very full and on the boots, Hafeez misses his tuck. It hits his boot and goes behind square on the leg side. A leg bye collected.
On middle, it is worked to mid-wicket for two.
Short and outside off, Hafeez strokes it firmly but the man at point dives and keeps it out. A run in the end.

FOUR! Good batting. We are entering a passage now where the Kiwis must understand that this is the best way to shut the Pakistanis down. Full and on the pads, easy pickings for Mohammad. He closes the face of his bat and wrists it to the fine leg boundary.
This is worked behind square on the off side for a single.
On middle, Faheem wrists it to deep mid-wicket. Deep square leg runs to his right and a couple taken meanwhile.
Good length ball around off, worked to the on side.

Not a drop catch. It was just a half a chance. Shortish and around off, the slower one. Hafeez looks to cut it but the ball is too close to his body. He ends up getting an outside edge. It goes wide of the keeper who dives to his right but cannot get hold of it. A single.
Faheem Ashraf is the new man in at the crease. Also, Trent Boult to bowl now. He has numbers, 2-0-13-0.

OUT! TAKEN! Great awareness from Martin. He held onto the catch and managed to keep himself inside the ropes as well. Tossed up around off, Khushdil Shah puts the dancing shoes on, he skips down and looks to clear long on. He almost did so as well, but Martin there, leaps and takes the catch. Does well to balance himself from going over.
Stroked uppishly but it lands safely ahead of long on, a single.
Shortish and outside off, Hafeez misses to connect on his cut.

SIX! Guptill gets high but cannot get high enough. Fullish and outside off, Mohammad comes down the track and lofts it high in the air. Martin Guptill, at long off, leaps high but cannot get hold of it. The ball sails just over him and into the fence for a maximum.
FOUR! Nice shot. Full and outside off, Mohammad Hafeez strokes it through the point region and fetches himself a boundary.
Full and around off, Shah clubs it down the ground for one.
Outside off on a short length, Hafeez looks to ramp it over the keeper's head, down to third man, but he misses to do that.
SIX! 50-run partnership up between these two! Full and on the off pole line, Hafeez comes on his front foot and lofts it over the covers for a maximum.
SIX! 50 for Hafeez as well! Short ball, Mohammad rocks back and pulls it over the deep backward square leg boundary. How does that feel, he asks!

DROPPED! Picked out Devon Conway alright. But he drops it. Full and on off and middle, Mohammad Hafeez closes the face of his bat to glance it. It goes uppishly towards fine leg. Devon runs forward, dives but fails to take it. A couple.
Fullish and outside off, a one-handed lofted baseball shot from Hafeez. Gets it over the covers. Boult gives it chase, dives in the end and keeps it out from going into the boundary. A brace.

Fullish and around off, Khushdil looked to slam it through the covers but ends up mistiming it to mid off. Calls for a quick single, risky, but gets to the other end. The throw comes there but misses to hit the stumps.
Shortish and outside off, Hafeez looks to cut but misses it again.
Sharp turn there. Flatter and outside off, Mohammad goes back and looks to cut it. But he misses on account of the turn. 'Lovely Ish' says the keeper.
Outside off, flat, punched to deep point for one.
Shorter and outside off, MH comes down the track and drives it through the covers for a single.
On off, punched through the covers for a single.
Outside off, dabbed behind square on the off side for a single.
Full on middle, Khushdil flicks it to the deep mid-wicket region for a couple.
On middle, tapped to the leg side for a dot.
On off, blocked to the off side.
FOUR! Good shot. Full and on middle, Khushdil flicks it to the deep square leg region for a boundary.
Good shot. Full and on the off stump, Hafeez drives it straight past the bowler for one.
On the pads, Khushdil closes the face of his bat to flick it down to fine leg. A single.

FOUR! No, Sodhi cannot finish the over well. Was a good over till that ball. Flat and on the off pole, Hafeez backs away and pulls it. Pulls it firmly to the deep mid-wicket fence. The fielder in the deep gives chase but cannot cut it off as it was stroked well wide of him.
Flatter and outside off, cut to point.
Tossed up around off, blocked to the off side.
Shortish and outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
Shorter and on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Flatter and around off, punched to cover.
Ish Sodhi in, first time in the night.
Two to finish the over. Full and on middle, Hafeez glances it uppishly. Conway gets to his left from deep backward square leg and stops it. Two runs though.
Outside off, blocked to the off side. Mohammad says 'no' to the single.
Good length ball around off, defended to the off side.

FOUR! Off the edge. Still, it was well waited and controlled by the batsman. Fullish and outside off, Mohammad Hafeez hops and strokes it off the outer half. Third man runs to his left but there is no chance for him to stop that.
On the pads, Khushdil Shah looks to tuck it to the leg side but misses. It hits his pads and goes down to fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Outside off on a good length, Hafeez taps it behind square on the off side, Martin Guptill runs to it from point. But a run is taken in the meanwhile.
Around off on a length, Mohammad taps it to the on side for one. 10 overs done, the visitors are 65/4.
On the pads, clipped behind square on the leg side for a single.
Good length ball around off, defended to the off side.

'Catch it' is the call but it falls safe. Shortish ball on top of off, Shah jumps and looks to play at it. The ball though takes the shoulder of his blade and lobs on the off side. Falls safely though.
Good length ball around off, dabbed behind square on the off side for a single.

FOUR! Ah... that's a nice cover drive. For a boundary. Very full and around off, Mohammad Hafeez comes forward, uses the pace of the ball and drives it through the covers for a boundary. Southee gives chase but quickly gives up as well, seeing how exceptionally well it was timed.
Good first over from James. Back of a length ball around off, Khushdil Shah looked to work it wide of the keeper, down towards third man. Misses though.
Outside off, Hafeez uses the pace of the ball and nudges it well to the left of point and takes one. That is good. Keep taking the singles.
This time he stabs the good length ball wide of the man at point and takes a single to get off the mark.
In the air again.... but lands in no man's land. On the pads, Khushdil flicks it. The ball goes uppish but lands well and safe ahead of mid on.
Who's in now? Khusdhil Shah it is.

OUT! TAKEN! Another soft dismissal. This time it is the skipper. Seems to have become a trend from Pakistan. Looking to go square again, Shadab. Shortish length ball around off, Khan looks to swing it on the leg side. He though ends up getting a top edge. Tim Southee, at short mid-wicket, goes to his left, all the while, keeping his eyes on the ball. Takes it safely.
Full and outside off, a beautiful shot. A Test match type of shot. Driven through cover-point for one, as deep cover runs to his left to cut it off.
James Neesham is in to bowl now.
Play and a miss! Fullish and outside off, Shadab Khan looks to play at it but misses to do so. Swing and a miss, in fact.
Short and outside off, Khan looks to slash it hard but ends up missing it there.
Good length ball outside off, worked with soft hands to the left of first slip, who dives, along with the keeper. The ball is kept out but not the single.
FOUR! Nicely played. NICELY PLAYED! Full and outside off, Hafeez goes back, uses the pace and strokes it wide of Neesham at first skip. No chance for Southee at third man.

FOUR! Ah... that is a nice shot. Look at the timing. Full and outside off, Mohammad Hafeez comes on the front foot and drives it through cover-point for a boundary. He has certainly increased his power. 50 up for Pakistan as well. In the 8th over.
Very full on off, dug out to the off side.
Scott Kuggelijin to bowl now. Not going to be Tim Southee for the New Zealenders.
Good length ball around off, worked to the off side for a dot.

EDGY FOUR! This one beats 'em all. Short boundaries here. Shortish and around off, Shadab Khan looks to cut it but gets an inside edge. It goes safely past the stumps. The keeper and few other fielders give chase but the ball beats them all to the fine leg fence.
Fullish and around off, defended to the off side for a single.

FOUR! That is nice. That is pretty. Full and on middle, Mohammad comes down the track a little. Lets out a pick up shot and flicks it in front of square on the on side. Uppish but safe and into the deep mid-wicket boundary.
FOUR! Now, that is a shot. That one did now swing. A wide half-volley from Kyle Jamieson, Hafeez comes on the front foot and strokes it wide of the man at point for a boundary.
Good length ball on the stumps, defended to the off side.
BEATEN! It is swinging alright. Fullish and around off, Khan prods forward and looks to block but the ball whizzes past his outside edge.
It is swinging. Full and outside off, Shadab goes for the drive but misses there, as the ball moves away from his outside edge.
Who will walk out to bat now? It is the skipper, Shadab Khan.

OUT! EDGED AND CAUGHT! Sometimes, the bowler is just too good. Test match line and length here. The outcome for New Zealand is perfect. Full and just outside off, Rizwan comes forward and goes for the cover drive. He though gets an outside edge and it goes to the left of the keeper. Seifert takes it with ease.
Full on middle, Hafeez taps it to mid on. Calls for a single and gets it, as Jamieson underarms a throw and hits the stumps at the bowler's end. Hafeez is in with the dive though.
Outside off, left alone.
Full and outside off, stabbed to the left of deep backward point for a single. Rotation of strike is a good thing that the Pakistanis must continue to do.
This is tapped to the leg side for a dot.
Short ball, pulled to deep square leg for a single.

In the air... but just wide again. This time it is Martin at point. Short and outside off, Rizwan strokes it firmly. He cuts it. It goes just wide of Guptill at point, despite his dive. Goes to the deep point region and two runs are taken.
Shortish and outside off, seams back in sharply after pitching, squares up Rizwan as he looks to cut it. Ends up chopping it to the point region.

Ohh.... just wide. Would have been a beauty. Good length ball outside off, Hafeez goes for the drive. Gets an outside edge. It goes just wide of James' outstreched arm at first slip and down to third man. A single collected.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Hafeez looks to work this to the leg side but misses to get hit high on the pads.
Kyle Jamieson to bowl now.

FOUR! Through. That is just good classic, simple batting. Full and outside off, Rizwan comes on the front foot. He drives it through the covers, through a diving cover fielder. Mid off gives chase but the ball had enough timing on it to go to the fence.
Full and around off, pushed down to mid off.
Good length ball around off, Hafeez stabs this to point for a run.
Oh... that is swinging here. Full and on the pads, Rizwan looks to work it to the on side but gets a leading edge. It goes safely through the carpet to third man. One run taken.
Slash and a miss! On a length and outside off, Rizwan goes hard after it but misses. No need to do anything silly here, Mohammad Rizwan.
BEATEN! Oh... that has gone, that swung and bounced. Lands on a fullish length outside off, it swings away, bounces. Goes past the outside edge of Rizwan who looked to defend that one.
Good length ball around off, tapped to the off side. Hafeez looks for a single but goes back later on.
Length delivery around off, nudged to the off side for a dot.
Outside off, Rizwan nudges it to the left of short third man. The fielder there, Ish, dives to his left and keeps it out, a single though.
On a length and outside off, pushed to the off side.
FOUR! Wonderful boundary. Good shot. Short ball, Mohammad Rizwan rocks back and pulls it to the deep backward square leg fence.
Fullish and around off, Rizwan taps it to the off side. He comes down, looking for a single, but Hafeez says no.
Mohammad Hafeez now walks out to bat!

OUT! TAKEN! Oh..no! No, no, no! Tries to go square but ends up popping the simplest of catches to Tim Southee. Shortish ball around off, Abdullah looks to work this on the leg side. But he ends up stopping midway, through the shot. Ends up chipping it high in the air. Tim runs forward and takes an easy catch.
Fullish and around off, Abdullahs stabs this to the leg side. Mohammad looks for a single but Abdullah sends him back.
Abdullah Shafique walks out to bat!

OUT! CAUGHT! It is good captaincy and good bowling from Southee. Splices it to the captain, Kane, does Haider. It is an early blow for Pakistan. Fullish and around off, Haider looks to slog it on the off side. He wanted to clear mid off but does not time it right at all. Ends up splicing it in the air towards mid off, where Williamson, backpedals a little and takes the catch.
Bumper from Tim, Ali stays deep in his crease and looks to pull but the ball bounces over him.
SIX! Oh...hello! Now, that's some statement. Full and on off, Haider launches it well over long on. Straight into the hospitality area there.

On the pads, Haider Ali whips it to the deep square leg region. Looks to be going for a boundary but Devon runs to his right, from deep mid-wicket. Displays outstanding commitment to dive and stop that. Keeps it down to a couple.
Tim Southee to bowl from the other end!
On a length and outside off, Mohammad forces it on the off side but cover-point gets to his left and keeps it out.
FOUR! Good shot. Oh... he hit that all right. Short ball, Mohammad Rizwan comes forward and goes for the pull shot. Yes, on the front foot. Sends it to the deep backward square leg boundary.
Good length ball around off, dabbed to the off side.
FOUR! That will do. Did not time it brilliantly though. Full and outside off, Rizwan leans into the drive and carves it through point. The fielder there, dives to his right but fails to keep it out.
Length delivery around off, Mohammad pushes it back to Trent.
Gun barrel full toss outside off, pushed to mid on for a dot.
Right, we are all set to begin then. Mohammad Rizwan and Haider Ali are the openers for Pakistan. Trent Boult with the ball first up. Here he comes...

Haris Rauf is up for a chat with Brendon McCullum. He says that when he tried hard ball cricket the first time, he was loving it. Adds that the first ball that he bowled was close to 150 kph and the second one touched 150. Adds that in the Big Bash, in the match where he got a hat-trick, the hat-trick ball was bowled around 150 kph. States that he always goes for the wicket. On that hat-trick wicket, Haris says that he took the wicket with full confidence. States that it was a big crowd in Melbourne then.

Kyle Jamieson is down for a chat. He says that a couple of deliveries moved in the last game. On the transition from Test to T20, Kyle says that there is not a whole lot different. Belives in keeping things simple on the whole. Adds that there are a lot of danger spinners in the Pakistan order and that their side did well, overall, in the first T20I.

New Zealand (Playing XI) - Martin Guptill, Tim Seifert (WK), Kane Williamson (C) (IN PLACE OF MITCHELL SANTNER), Devon Conway, Glenn Phillips, James Neesham, Kyle Jamieson (IN PLACE OF MARK CHAPMAN), Scott Kuggeleijn, Ish Sodhi, Tim Southee (IN PLACE OF JACOB DUFFY), Trent Boult (IN PLACE OF BLAIR TICKNER).

Pakistan (Unchanged Playing XI) - Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Abdullah Shafique, Haider Ali, Mohammad Hafeez, Shadab Khan (C), Khushdil Shah, Imad Wasim, Faheem Ashraf, Wahab Riaz, Shaheen Afridi, Haris Rauf.

Kane Williamson, New Zealand's captain, says that he looks to do well with the ball. Adds that the last few days (birth of his first child) has been amazing. States that it is a cool environment and that now, there is a change of focus (smiles). On the changes, Williamson elaborates on a number of them. Promiment in it is that the 3 Test seamers make their way in. Adds further that Mitchell and Astle will be missing out.

Shadab Khan, Pakistan's skipper, says that the wants to bat first. Feels that the top-order batsmen have to chip in with the runs and hopes to get a good total onboard. Adds that in the subcontinent there is not much issue with bounce and here, admits they are struggling a little with the bounce. Adds that they are unchanged for this game.
TOSS - The two captains are out in the middle for the coin toss. Kane Williamson and Shadab Khan are the skippers. Pakistan have won the toss again. THEY WILL BAT!

Hello and welcome to our coverage of the 2nd T20I between New Zealand and Pakistan. The action now shifts to Seddon Park for the same and whether you bat first or bowl, does not make much of a difference. Reason being that both are level in terms of the sides who opted to do either and have won later on. So, win or lose the toss, should not matter much. But what does matter for one side, and that is Pakistan, is that they must win. And that task got a little more complex as they failed to cash in on a second-string Kiwi side earlier. And now, they have to contend with the big guns - Williamson, Southee, Boult, Jamieson and Mitchell. Let's see how they go about in this rocky journey. For now, the toss and teams are coming up in a while...
